sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners after arguing the matter for sometime submits that the petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioners to avail the remedy under the provisions of Code of Criminal Procedure before the Trial Court to discharge the petitioners.
Submission is placed on record.
Petition is dismissed as not pressed with liberty as prayed for.
All contentions urged in this petitions are left open.
